text: Fix a crash in job planning, then turn planning back on. The first planned job (20261017-204355-358k) crashed athena go: its plan listed the directory docs/, and Athena's own plan check (crates/athena-core/src/run.rs, the existence check that calls self.git.show_file(&p, path)) failed with 'git cat-file blob <base>:docs/ failed ... bad file'. Git::show_file (crates/athena-git/src/lib.rs) checks existence with cat-file -e, which succeeds for a tree, and then reads it as a blob. Plan: (1) show_file returns None for a path that is not a blob, so no caller can crash on a directory. (2) Athena's plan checks turn a planned path that is a directory, or is not a plain relative file path, into a major finding that sends the plan back, never an error. (3) In athena.toml set [job_plan] enabled = true again; it was turned off by hand after the crash. Acceptance: cargo test: show_file on a directory returns None with no error; cargo test: a fake plan that lists 'docs/' gets an Athena major finding and the job goes on to the next round, with no crash; cargo test --locked, clippy -D warnings, fmt --check and xtask's boundary test pass; athena.toml has [job_plan] enabled = true; CHANGELOG.md names the crash and the job.
